nodes.name: Spark from the Frost
nodes.description:
Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker
When the Solid-State Ichor of Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution: Glare is hurled out, press Normal Attack in mid-air to cast Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker.
Slam down from the air to detonate the Ichor Deposit, dealing Spectro DMG (considered Basic Attack DMG) and recovering all STA.
Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker is no longer available when Resonance Liberation Rewritten in Winter's Margins is cast or Luuk Herssen is switched off the field.

Aureate Judge
With full Ichor Flow, enter the Aureate Judge state. In this state, Luuk Herssen gains the following effects:
- Ichor Flow does not restore. The DMG Multipliers of all forms of Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution increase by 110%.
- Casting Aureole of Execution: Glare increases the DMG Multiplier of the next Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker and Ichor Deposit DMG by 110%.
- 100 points of Ichor Flow is consumed each time Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution is cast.
- Aureate Judge ends when Ichor Flow depletes.

Golden Rule
When Luuk Herssen is in the team, all other Resonators in the team gain Golden Rule. When Resonators with Golden Rule cast Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator is Luuk Herssen, remove all Golden Rules on Resonators in the team and grant Luuk Herssen 200 points of Ichor Flow and 12 points of Concerto Energy. Resonators in the team gain Golden Rule again after 24s. This effect does not apply in Co-op Mode.

Dawnlit Keep
Luuk Herssen gains 1 stacks of Dawnlit Keep when he stays out of combat for over 4s or casts Intro Skill Before Injection of Dawn.
Dawnlit Keep is capped at 1 stack. When taking damage from enemies, consume 1 stacks of Dawnlit Keep to reduce the DMG taken by 60% and gain immunity to interruptions for 1s. This effect can be triggered once per second.

Radiant Reave
When Luuk Herssen performs Dodge in mid-air, he briefly stays airborne and hurls out an Ichor Blade.
Luuk Herssen consumes STA continuously while airborne.
If Luuk Herssen is launched into mid-air, press Dodge before landing to trigger this effect, up to 3 times. When he is on the ground or switched out for more than 3s, the trigger count is reset.

Ichor Blade
Deal fixed Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG that is not affected by any DMG Bonus.
Only one Ichor Blade can exist at a time. It cannot trigger Counterattack.
Ichor Blade cannot be launched without a nearby target.
Ichor Blade disappears when Luuk Herssen casts other skills that deal damage or leaves the field.

Ichor Flow
Luuk Herssen holds up to 300 points of Ichor Flow.
Normal Attacks, Resonance Skill Golden Reflux, Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution, Basic Attack - Golden Impale, and Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker restore Ichor Flow on hit.
Casting Intro Skill Before Injection of Dawn restores 100 points of Ichor Flow.

nodes.description:
Optical Sampling Stage
Lynae is in Optical Sampling Stage by default. While in this state, Overflow recovers during certain skills.

Kaleidoscopic Parade
Casting Basic Attack - Spark Collision sends Lynae into Kaleidoscopic Parade. In this state, Lynae continuously recovers Lumiflow while moving on the ground or during certain periods of certain skills. Lynae will not Walk during this state, and her Running and Sprinting will be replaced by the faster Free Skating and Speed Skating.

Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap
While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, with at least 1/3 of the max Lumiflow, Jump is replaced by Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap.
Consume 1/3 of the max Lumiflow to deal Spectro DMG. Inflict Photochromic Flux on targets hit. Successful Dodges can be triggered within a certain time during this skill. While airborne, Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap chains up to 3 stages. Switching to another Resonator resets the combo.
While in combat, each stage of Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap cast recovers 1 point of True Color.
Within a certain time after Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap Stage 1 press Normal Attack on the ground to cast Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2.
Casting Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap Stage 2 also pulls in nearby targets.

Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash
During Kaleidoscopic Parade, when Lynae is in mid-air with 3 points of True Color, and Basic Attack - Visual Impact is on cooldown, press Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to deal Spectro DMG and inflict Photochromic Flux on targets hit.
This skill consumes 3 points of True Color.
Press Normal Attack within a certain time during this skill to cast Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2.

Basic Attack - Visual Impact
During Kaleidoscopic Parade, when Lynae is in mid-air with 3 points of True Color, and this skill is not on cooldown, press Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to deal Spectro DMG and inflict Photochromic Flux on targets hit.
This skill consumes 3 points of True Color and grants all nearby Resonators in the team 40 points of Tune Break Boost for 30s.
Press Normal Attack within a certain time during this skill to cast Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2.

Resonance Mode
Inflict Photochromic Flux when hitting a target with Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap, Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash, Basic Attack - Visual Impact and Intro Skill - Time to Show Some Colors!.
Lynae can switch between Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture and Resonance Mode - Tune Strain:
- When in Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture, Photochromic Flux inflicts Tune Rupture - Shifting on targets for 25s.
- When in Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, Photochromic Flux inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting on targets for 25s.

Tune Rupture Response - Spectral Analysis
Deal an instance of Spectro DMG, considered Tune Rupture DMG, to targets within range affected by Tune Rupture - Interfered.

Overflow
Lynae can hold up to 120 points of Overflow.
While in Optical Sampling Stage, Overflow recovers during Basic Attack, Lynae-Style Palettes, Mid-air Attack, and Dodge Counter, or when Intro Skill is cast.
When Overflow is full, Basic Attack - Spark Collision becomes available.
Casting Basic Attack - Spark Collision removes all Overflow.

Lumiflow
Lynae can hold up to 120 points of Lumiflow.
During Kaleidoscopic Parade:
- Restore 20% of Lumiflow per second when Lynae is moving on the ground/climbing, or performs a successful Dodge on the ground, or within a certain time during Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack, Kaleidoscopic Parade - Ground Heavy Attack, Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack, Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter, Additive Color, ground Dodge, Intro Skill, or Basic Attack - To a Vivid Tomorrow!.
- Lumiflow starts to deplete by 20% per second while Lynae is staying still on the ground/climbing/swimming or off the field, or after a certain time following the use of the skills listed above.
- Lumiflow does not change while Lynae is not in any of the states described above.
Exiting Kaleidoscopic Parade removes all Lumiflow.
With 120 points of Lumiflow, Lynae's roller skating speed further increases. Speed Skating consumes STA over time.

True Color
Lynae can hold up to 3 points of True Color.
During combat, each time Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap is cast, gain 1 point of True Color. With 3 points of True Color, Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash and Basic Attack - Visual Impact become available.
Exiting Kaleidoscopic Parade removes all True Color.

Expectation Error

If attacked while in the Parry state, exit the state and cast Resonance Skill - Optimal Solution.
If not attacked while in the Parry state, press Normal Attack to exit the state and cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Optimal Solution
Stagnate nearby targets and deal Fusion DMG, reducing the cooldown of Resonance Skill - Expectation Error by 2s.
Switching to another Resonator ends the Stagnation effect early.

Distributed Array
While in Wide Field Observation Mode, Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill - Distributed Array.

When casting this skill, if a Syntony Field is present, remove it and generate a High Syntony Field.
Can be performed in mid-air.

High Syntony Field
- High Syntony Field lasts for 25s.
- Increases the DEF of all nearby Resonators in the team within the High Syntony Field by 20%.
- Inherits the Syntony Field's boost to resistance to interruption and Off-Tune Buildup Rate.

- When the active Resonator takes a fatal blow, they are not downed by this instance of damage. This effect can trigger up to 1 times. Proof of Boundedness is removed after triggering it 1 times.
- When Proof of Boundedness is removed, the active Resonator restores HP equal to 150% of Mornye's DEF.

nodes.name: Mass-Energy Equivalence
nodes.description:
Baseline Mode
While in her default Baseline Mode, Mornye gains Rest Mass Energy.

Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift
When Rest Mass Energy reaches 100 points, Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift.
Cast Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift to deal Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG. Afterward, Mornye jumps into mid-air, consumes all Rest Mass Energy and enters Wide Field Observation Mode.

Wide Field Observation Mode
Wide Field Observation Mode lasts for 30s.
- Upon entering Wide Field Observation Mode, Mornye generates a Syntony Field.
- While in Wide Field Observation Mode, Mornye gains Relative Momentum.
- If Relative Momentum is below 100 when holding Normal Attack, perform Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode Stage 1 to 3 in sequence. If Relative Momentum reaches 100 during this time, cast Heavy Attack - Inversion instead.
- While moving, Mornye continuously consumes STA. STA cannot be recovered while in Wide Field Observation Mode.
- When Dodging with directional input, Mornye starts to fly at speed, which lasts for up to 10s or until STA is depleted or until the Wide Field Observation Mode ends.
- When Mornye is hit or launched into mid-air, press Dodge to immediately recover from the attack, which is considered a successful Dodge. This effect can be triggered up to 3 times, which resets when Wide Field Observation Mode ends.
- Press Jump and Mornye will slowly descend. Before she lands, Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode, Resonance Skill - Distributed Array, and Heavy Attack - Inversion are unavailable. If Jump is pressed when Mornye runs out of STA, she will exit the Wide Field Observation Mode. She will leave the Wide Field Observation Mode also when she Dodges, Jumps, or performs Mid-air Attacks.
Additionally, performing environmental interactions, using Utilities, or switching to another Resonator ends Wide Field Observation Mode. The state also ends when Mornye is no longer airborne.

Syntony Field
- Syntony Field lasts for 25s.
- When the Syntony Field is generated, deal Fusion DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
- Continuously restores HP for nearby active Resonators in the team within the Syntony Field, triggered once every 3s.
- Increases the Off-Tune Buildup Rate of all nearby Resonators in the team within the Syntony Field by 50%.
- Enhances the resistance to interruption of nearby active Resonators in the team within the Syntony Field.

Heavy Attack - Inversion
- When Relative Momentum reaches 100 points, Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack - Inversion.
- Consume all Relative Momentum to cast Heavy Attack - Inversion, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
- Heavy Attack - Inversion inflicts Observation Marker upon the target on hit for 30s.

Observation Marker
When a Resonator in the team deals Tune Break DMG to a target inflicted with Observation Marker, Mornye inflicts an Interfered Marker on the target for 8s.

Interfered Marker
Targets affected by Tune Rupture - Interfered or Tune Strain - Interfered take increased DMG from all nearby Resonators in the team. For every 1% of Mornye's Energy Regen exceeding 100%, their DMG is increased by 0.25%, up to 40%.

Visual Field
When a Resonator in the team defeats a target inflicted with Observation Marker or Interfered Marker, Mornye gains Visual Field for 3s. While in this state, Mornye inflicts Observation Marker on the target hit whenever any Resonator in the team deals damage.

Tune Rupture Response - Particle Jet
Mornye deals one instance of Fusion DMG to targets in the Tune Rupture - Interfered state within range, considered Tune Rupture DMG.

Rest Mass Energy
Mornye can hold up to 100 points of Rest Mass Energy.
While in Baseline Mode, she gains Rest Mass Energy when performing Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Dodge Counter, or when Resonance Skill - Optimal Solution hits a target.

Relative Momentum
Mornye can hold up to 100 points of Relative Momentum.
While in Wide Field Observation Mode, she gains Relative Momentum when Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode, Dodge Counter - Wide Field Observation Mode or Resonance Skill - Distributed Array hits the target.
Mornye cannot gain Relative Momentum during Heavy Attack - Inversion.

When Mortefi's Annoyance reaches 100, his Resonance Skill is replaced with Fury Fugue.
When casting Fury Fugue, Mortefi consumes all Annoyance to unleash high-speed flame lightning, dealing Fusion DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.

Annoyance
Mortefi can hold up to 100 Annoyance and can restore Annoyance in the following ways:
- When Normal Attack Impromptu Show hits the target
- When Intro Skill Dissonance hits the target
- When Resonance Skill Passionate Variation hits the target
- Within 5s after casting Passionate Variation, Normal Attack Impromptu Show that hits the target restores Annoyance additionally.

nodes.name: Rage Transposition
nodes.description: The incoming Resonator gains 38% Heavy Attack DMG Amplification for 14s or until they are switched out.

nodes.name: O Come Divine Light
nodes.description:
Basic Attack
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks of Holy Light, dealing Spectro DMG.

Heavy Attack
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to ride the staff and dive down from mid-air to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.

Mid-air Heavy Attack
Consume STA to ride on the staff for a distance.
- Can be re-cast after a Mid-Air Dodge or using Grapple.

Dodge Counter
After a successful Dodge, quickly use Basic Attack to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
- When Phoebe is inside the Ring of Mirrors, Dodge Counter becomes Chamuel's Star: Dodge Counter.

nodes.name: To Where Light Shines
nodes.description:
Summon a Ring of Mirrors at the target location, making the target hit stagnate for 2s and dealing Spectro DMG. The stagnation effect can be applied to 12 targets max for each Ring of Mirrors. Using Resonance Skill again shortly after the summoning teleports Phoebe to the Ring of Mirrors' location, dealing Spectro DMG.
Unable to teleport if Phoebe is too far from the Ring of Mirrors.

Ring of Mirrors
- Ring of Mirrors lasts for 30s. When Phoebe summons a new Ring of Mirrors, the existing Ring of Mirrors disappears.
- When Phoebe is outside of the Ring of Mirrors, a Basic Attack or Dodge Counter that hits the Ring of Mirrors will refract Holy Light, which deals Spectro DMG to targets inside the Ring of Mirrors and pulls the targets hit to the center of the ring. The DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG. Can be triggered once every 0.5s.
- When Phoebe is inside the Ring of Mirrors, Basic Attack becomes Basic Attack Chamuel's Star, which performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

values.name: Ring of Mirrors: Refracted Holy Light DMG

nodes.name: Dawn of Enlightenment
nodes.description:
Phoebe concentrates the light in her hands into the Mirror of Enlightenment and smashes it, dealing Spectro DMG.
- Absolution Enhancement: Increase DMG Multiplier by 255%.
- Confession Enhancement: Apply 8 stacks of Spectro Frazzle to targets hit.

nodes.name: Presence
nodes.description: Mid-air Heavy Attack can be cast 1 more times.

nodes.name: Revelation
nodes.description: When in the Absolution status and Confession status, Spectro DMG Bonus is increased by 12%.

nodes.name: Golden Grace
nodes.description: Knock back nearby targets and deal Spectro DMG.

nodes.name: Radiant Invocation
nodes.description:
When Phoebe's Prayer is full, consume all Prayer to cast one of the following skills:
- Hold Basic Attack to cast Heavy Attack Absolution Litany, dealing Spectro DMG and applying 1 stack of Spectro Frazzle to the targets hit. Phoebe enters Absolution status, which allows her to deal more damage.
- Hold Resonance Skill to cast Resonance Skill Utter Confession, dealing Spectro DMG and applying 1 stack of Spectro Frazzle to the targets hit. Phoebe enters Confession status, which allows her to better exploit Spectro Frazzle.
- Absolution and Confession cannot coexist. Entering into one will end the other.
- When Divine Voice is not exhausted, Phoebe is unable to cast Heavy Attack Absolution Litany and Resonance Skill Utter Confession.
- When Divine Voice is exhausted, Phoebe will not exit the Absolution or Confession status.

Heavy Attack: Starflash
When Phoebe has Divine Voice, casting Basic Attack Stage 3 or Dodge Counter replaces the next Heavy Attack with Heavy Attack: Starflash, which deals Spectro DMG at the cost of 30 Divine Voice.
- Absolution Enhancement: Reduce the cost of Divine Voice by 15. When the targets hit have Spectro Frazzle, the skill gains 256% DMG Amplification.
- Confession Enhancement: Apply 5 stacks of Spectro Frazzle to the targets hit.

Prayer 
Phoebe can hold up to 120 Prayer.
Phoebe automatically gains 5 Prayer every second.

Divine Voice
Phoebe can hold up to 60 Divine Voice.
Casting Heavy Attack Absolution Litany or Resonance Skill Utter Confession restores 60 Divine Voice.

nodes.name: Attentive Heart
nodes.description:
Deal Spectro DMG equal to 528.41% of Phoebe's ATK to nearby targets.
- Absolution Enhancement: Increase DMG Multiplier by 255%.
- Confession Enhancement: Grant Silent Prayer to the Resonator on the field, reducing the Spectro RES of nearby targets by 10% and granting 100% Spectro Frazzle DMG Amplification. When Spectro Frazzle inflicts DMG, extend Spectro Frazzle's damage interval by 50%. This effect lasts 30s or until Phoebe switches to Absolution status.

nodes.name: Movement of Life and Death
nodes.description:
Basic Attack
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG.
When performing Basic Attack Stage 3, enter Reincarnate state.

Heavy Attack
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Scarlet Coda
Phrolova enters the Compose state every 25s.
When the following 3 conditions are met, Heavy Attack is replaced with Scarlet Coda.
- Has 6 Volatile Notes.
- In the Compose state.
- Not in the Resolving Chord state.

Scarlet Coda: Consume STA to deal Havoc DMG, Stagnating and pulling in nearby targets. This instance of damage is considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Each stack of Aftersound additionally increases the DMG Multiplier of this instance of damage.
Casting this skill is considered as casting Echo Skill.
Casting this skill sends Compose state into cooldown and activates the Resolving Chord state.

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Havoc DMG.

Dodge Counter
Press Normal Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

nodes.name: Whispers in a Fleeting Dream
nodes.description:
Attack the target and deal Havoc DMG.
Casting this skill sends Phrolova into Reincarnate.

nodes.name: Waltz of Forsaken Depths
nodes.description:
Waltz of Forsaken Depths
Phrolova's max Resonance Energy is 0. Waltz of Forsaken Depths does not consume Resonance Energy.
When in the Resolving Chord state, Waltz of Forsaken Depths becomes available.
Casting this skill ends the Resolving Chord state, and Phrolova enters the Maestro state for 24s.

Maestro
Gain 120% ATK increase.
Phrolova floats in the air and commands Hecate to fight. Hecate will share Phrolova's stats and statuses, and damage dealt by Hecate will be considered coming from Phrolova. Hecate's attacks will not remove the target's Hazy Dream state.
During this period, Phrolova plays the Volatile Notes in turn. Each Volatile Note holds for 4s.
If Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, she can give the following cues to Hecate. Any damage taken by Hecate in this state affects Phrolova as well.
- Cue - Basic Attack: Press Normal Attack to command Hecate to cast Basic Attack - Hecate. When Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, for every 2 times Hecate casts Basic Attack - Hecate, the next Basic Attack - Hecate is replaced with Enhanced Attack - Hecate.
- Cue - Dodge: Press Dodge to command Hecate to dodge an attack. Hecate takes no damage from a hit successfully Dodged.
- Cue - Reset: Press Jump to reset Hecate's position.
- Cue - Curtain Call: Press Resonance Liberation to command Hecate to cast Curtain Call and end the Maestro state.
When Phrolova is not the active Resonator, Hecate takes no damage and automatically casts Basic Attack - Hecate to attack the target. When Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Hecate casts Enhanced Attack - Hecate to attack the target. This effect can be triggered up to 10 times in total during Phrolova's Maestro state. Echoes of the same name can trigger this effect 1 times.
Switching back to Phrolova ends Maestro state.
Ending Maestro state removes all Volatile Notes.

Basic Attack - Hecate
Perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings
When Phrolova plays Volatile Note - Strings, Hecate casts Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings when casting Enhanced Attack - Hecate, dealing Havoc DMG and Stagnating the targets (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds
When Phrolova plays Volatile Note - Winds, Hecate casts Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds when casting Enhanced Attack - Hecate, dealing Havoc DMG, pulling the targets in (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza
When Phrolova plays Volatile Note - Cadenza, Hecate casts Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza when casting Enhanced Attack - Hecate, dealing Havoc DMG, Stagnating and pulling the targets in (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Curtain Call
Curtain Call can be cast via the following 5 ways, Stagnating the targets and dealing Havoc DMG.
- When Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, end the Maestro state.
- When Phrolova is in the Maestro state, switch to Phrolova without casting Intro Skill.
- When Phrolova is not the active Resonator and the Maestro state ends, switch to Phrolova without casting Intro Skill.
- When Phrolova is in the Maestro state, press Resonance Liberation.
- When Phrolova is in the Resolving Chord state, hold Resonance Liberation.
When in Resolving Chord state, casting Curtain Call removes all Volatile Notes and ends the Resolving Chord state.

nodes.name: Accidental
nodes.description:
Casting Echo Skill grants increased resistance to interruption and reduces damage taken by 30% for 15s.
After casting Suite of Quietus, Suite of Immortality, and Echo Skill, the next Volatile Note becomes Volatile Note - Cadenza.

nodes.name: Octet
nodes.description:
Obtain 10 stacks of Aftersound upon entering battle. This effect cannot be triggered again within 4s after exiting the combat state. For every 1 stacks of Aftersound, Crit. DMG is increased by 2.5%.
When Aftersound reaches the max, each new stack of Aftersound increases Phrolova's Crit. DMG by 1%, up to 100%. The increased Crit. DMG is removed when Aftersound stacks are cleared.

nodes.name: Suite of Quietus
nodes.description:
Suite of Quietus
Attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

Suite of Immortality
When in the Maestro state, the next Suite of Quietus is replaced with Suite of Immortality. This replacement is cancelled if Curtain Call is cast while in this state. Suite of Immortality deals Havoc DMG (considered Resonance Skill DMG) and Stagnates the target.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

nodes.name: Rhapsody of a New World
nodes.description:
Basic Attack - Movement of Fate and Finality
When in Reincarnate, press Normal Attack on the ground to cast Movement of Fate and Finality, which Stagnates the target, dealing Havoc DMG (considered Resonance Skill DMG) and ending Reincarnate afterward.

Resonance Skill - Murmurs in a Haunting Dream
When in Reincarnate, press Resonance Skill on the ground to cast Murmurs in a Haunting Dream, dealing Havoc DMG (considered Resonance Skill DMG) and ending Reincarnate afterward.

Aftersound
Phrolova can hold up to 24 stacks of Aftersound.
When Phrolova is not the active Resonator, casting Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings, Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds, and Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza grants 1 stacks of Aftersound.
When Phrolova is out of combat, all stacks of Aftersound are removed every 30s.

Volatile Note
Phrolova can hold up to 6 Volatile Notes. When Volatile Notes reach the max number, gaining new Volatile Notes moves all Volatile Notes one slot to the left, and the leftmost Volatile Note - Strings or Volatile Note - Winds will be removed.
Hitting a target with Basic Attack Stage 3 or Movement of Fate and Finality grants 1 Volatile Note - Strings.
Hitting a target with Resonance Skill Whispers in a Fleeting Dream or Resonance Skill Murmurs in a Haunting Dream grants 1 Volatile Note - Winds.
When Inherent Skill - Accidental is activated, casting Suite of Quietus, Suite of Immortality, or Echo Skill grants 1 Volatile Note - Cadenza.
Phrolova cannot obtain Volatile Notes during Resolving Chord.

nodes.name: Unfinished Piece
nodes.description:
The incoming Resonator gains 20% Havoc DMG Amplification and 25% Heavy Attack DMG Amplification for 14s or until they are switched out.
If Phrolova is in Maestro state when she casts this skill, Hecate additionally casts Enhanced Attack - Hecate 2 times when Phrolova is switched off the field while in the same Maestro state duration.

nodes.name: Strings to Steel
nodes.description:
Basic Attack - Stringblade
Press repeatedly or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.
Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 1 and Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4 are in Sheathed Stance.
Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 2 and Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3 are in Drawn Stance.

Heavy Attack - Stringblade
When Qin Heart and Sword Cadence are full, Heavy Attack - Stringblade becomes available.
Hold Normal Attack to consume STA and cast this skill, dealing Aero DMG.
Casting this skill consumes all Qin Heart and Sword Cadence and sends Qingxiao into the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

Mid-air Attack - Stringblade
Press Normal Attack consecutively or hold it down to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.
This skill is in Drawn Stance.
After landing from Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3, press or hold Normal Attack within a certain time to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.
While in mid-air, Resonance Skill is replaced by Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.

Plunging Attack
While in the Sword Flight state, Jump is replaced by Plunging Attack.
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Aero DMG.
While out of the Ephemeral Transcendence state, press Normal Attack within a certain time after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.

Dodge Counter - Stringblade
Press Normal Attack within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
This skill is in Drawn Stance.
Press or hold Normal Attack within a certain time after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4.

Sword Glide
While in mid-air, Dodge is replaced by Sword Glide.

nodes.name: Severing Note
nodes.description:
Severing Note: Judgement
Deal Aero DMG. During this skill, gain 45 points of Qin Heart.
While not in the Ephemeral Transcendence state, press or hold Normal Attack within a certain time after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4.

Severing Note: Ascendant
While casting Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 2, Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3, or Dodge Counter - Stringblade, Resonance Skill is replaced by Severing Note: Ascendant.
Deal Aero DMG.
This skill is in Drawn Stance.

nodes.name: Billows Beneath Heaven
nodes.description:
Deal Aero DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

nodes.name: Sea of Thought, World of Dust
nodes.description:
Upon entering combat, gain 1 stacks of Gathered Mind.

After damage dealt directly by Resonators in the team defeats a target inflicted with the Mindlock effect:
If Qingxiao does not have the Gathered Mind effect, gain Gathered Mind with stacks equal to the target's Mindlock stacks.
If Qingxiao already has Gathered Mind and the target's Mindlock stacks are no fewer than Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks, Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks will be matched to the target's Mindlock stacks.

Gathered Mind
After Resonators in the team deal damage to a target, inflict Mindlock equal to Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks. This effect can only trigger 1 times on the same target.
When Resonators in the team cast Tune Break, if the target has Tune Strain - Shifting, additionally inflict 1 stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target. This effect can only trigger 1 times on the same target.
When Qingxiao is knocked out, she can no longer gain Gathered Mind, and any existing Gathered Mind effect becomes inactive.
Gathered Mind stacks up to 15 times and lasts for 30s.

nodes.name: To Know, To Banish
nodes.description:
Qingxiao's following skills deal 2% more DMG per stack of Mindlock on the target, with an additional 5% per stack for the first 7 stacks.
- Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven.

Each time after a Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Interfered on an Overlord Class or Calamity Class target, additionally inflict 1 stacks of Mindlock on the target.

nodes.name: Tonality Shift
nodes.description:
Deal Aero DMG. Casting the skill restores 30 points of Sword Cadence and grants Resonant Chime.

Resonant Chime
Casting Resonance Skill - Severing Note: Judgement grants 30 points of Qin Heart and removes Resonant Chime.

nodes.name: Formless Heart Sword
nodes.description:
Ephemeral Transcendence
While Qingxiao is in the Ephemeral Transcendence state, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence and Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence become available.

Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence
Press repeatedly or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.
Before Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence becomes available, this skill's DMG Multiplier is increased by 100%.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence
Press or hold Normal Attack within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
Before Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence becomes available, this skill's DMG Multiplier is increased by 100%.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence
When Heart Sword Intent is full, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence becomes available. Hold Normal Attack to cast the skill, dealing Aero DMG.
Casting this skill consumes all Heart Sword Intent and ends the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

Mindlock
Mindlock stacks up to 15 times.
Each time a Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Interfered on a target, inflict 1 stacks of Mindlock on the target.
For each stack of Mindlock on the target, DMG taken from Qingxiao's following skills is Amplified by 2%, with an additional 5% per stack for the first 7 stacks.
- Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven.

Heaven's Clarity
Upon entering combat or casting Resonance Liberation Billows Beneath Heaven, gain Heaven's Clarity.
When Sheathed Stance/Drawn Stance skills deal damage, the rates at which Qin Heart/Sword Cadence are obtained increase by 100%.
When casting Heavy Attack - Stringblade, inflict 3 stacks of Mindlock on nearby targets, and enhance the next Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence: its DMG Multiplier is increased by 100% and it builds additional Off-Tune Level on the target. Switching to another Resonator ends the Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence enhancement.
Casting Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence removes Heaven's Clarity.

Swordlight Ward
Casting Intro Skill - Tonality Shift or Heavy Attack - Stringblade grants 1 stacks of Swordlight Ward.
Swordlight Ward stacks up to 1 times. When taking DMG from an enemy's attack, 1 stacks of Swordlight Ward can be consumed to grant immunity to interruption and reduce DMG taken by 60% for 1s. This effect can be triggered once per second.

Sword Flight
While in the Sword Flight state, Qingxiao moves with a special animation.
Moving in Sword Flight continuously consumes Flight Qi.
- Casting the following skills sends Qingxiao into the Sword Flight state:
Sword Glide, Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 1, Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 2, Severing Note: Ascendant, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, and Intro Skill - Tonality Shift.
- Exit the Sword Flight state by:
1. Casting Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3 or Plunging Attack.
2. Triggering certain environmental interactions or Utilities.
3. Returning to the ground.
4. Switching to another Resonator.
5. Depleting all Flight Qi.

Sword Step
While in the Sword Flight state, hold Jump to leap up and dash forward a short distance.
Sword Step can only be cast once during Sword Flight.

Qin Heart
Can hold up to 100 points.
Dealing damage with Sheathed Stance skills grants Qin Heart.
Qin Heart cannot be gained while in the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

Sword Cadence
Can hold up to 100 points.
Dealing damage with Drawn Stance skills grants Sword Cadence.
Sword Cadence cannot be gained while in the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

Heart Sword Intent
Can hold up to 100 points.
Dealing damage with Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence or Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence grants Heart Sword Intent.

nodes.description:
Basic Attack
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.

Heavy Attack
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG. Press Normal Attack within a certain period of time after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash Stage 4.

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Aero DMG.

Dodge Counter
Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG, considered as Heavy Attack.
Moments after a Basic Attack or Heavy Attack, Qiuyuan becomes immune to the next instance of DMG he takes and casts Dodge Counter upon being attacked, dealing Aero DMG.

nodes.name: Through the Groves
nodes.description:
Press Resonance Skill to dash forward for a distance, dealing Aero DMG, considered as Echo Skill DMG. If Resonance Skill is cast upon being attacked by an enemy target, Qiuyuan becomes immune to this instance of DMG and stagnates nearby enemies, while gaining immunity to interruption during this Resonance Skill.
Switching to other Resonators removes the Stagnation effect from enemies.

Undaunted Wayfarer
Hold Resonance Skill to dash forward for a distance at the cost of STA, dealing Aero DMG to the target, considered as Echo Skill DMG.
If there are no targets nearby, Qiuyuan will leap up and dash through the air by continuously consuming STA until it runs out. Release Resonance Skill to immediately end the dash and land. If there are targets nearby when Qiuyuan lands, deal Aero DMG to nearby targets, considered as Echo Skill DMG. This skill can be cast in mid-air.

nodes.name: Sundering Strike
nodes.description:
Deal Aero DMG to targets within range, considered as Echo Skill DMG.
For every 1% of Qiuyuan's Crit. Rate over 50%, this skill increases the Crit. DMG of all nearby active Resonators in the team by 2% for 30s, up to 30%.

nodes.name: Quietude Within
nodes.description:
Qiuyuan obtains Quietude Within for 10s upon entering the Inksplash of Mind state. This effect can be triggered once every 22s.
Heavy Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: To Teach, Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save, and Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice deal 50% more DMG. Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice additionally restores 30 points of Concerto Energy on hit.
- This effect ends early when Qiuyuan is switched off the field.

nodes.name: Drink Away Woes Age-Old
nodes.description:
When casting Echo Skill, Qiuyuan's bamboo flask absorbs the overflowing energy and brews it into Flowing Panacea.
The next time Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained, the Flowing Panacea is consumed to gain 10% ATK increase for 20s.

nodes.name: Attack the Must-Defend
nodes.description:
Attack the target, dealing Aero DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
Within a certain period of time after casting this skill, press Normal Attack to perform Basic Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash Stage 3.

nodes.name: Verdant Edge
nodes.description:
Basic Attack - Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash
When Qiuyuan reaches 200 points of Swordster's Soliloquy, his Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash, which chains together up to 4 consecutive strikes, dealing Aero DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.

Bamboo's Shade
When Qiuyuan reaches 400 points of Swordster's Soliloquy, he gains the Bamboo's Shade effect, granting all nearby active Resonators in the team 30% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for 30s.

Inksplash of Mind
When Swordster's Soliloquy is full, Qiuyuan enters the Inksplash of Mind state for 8s, during which Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save.
In this state, hold Normal Attack to consume Swordster's Soliloquy to perform Heavy Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: To Teach, Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save, and Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice in order, dealing Aero DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
- Performing Thus Spoke the Blade: To Teach, Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save, or Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice is considered as performing Echo Skill.
- Inksplash of Mind ends when Swordster's Soliloquy is used up.

Swordster's Soliloquy
Qiuyuan can hold up to 600 points of Swordster's Soliloquy.
- 100 points of Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained when performing Basic Attack Stage 3.
- 100 points of Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained when performing each stage of Basic Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash.
- 100 points of Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained when performing Dodge Counter.
- 400 points of Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained when performing Intro Skill.
- Swordster's Soliloquy cannot be obtained in the Inksplash of Mind state.
- Swordster's Soliloquy is cleared when the Inksplash of Mind state ends.

nodes.name: Mix-'n'-Match
nodes.description:
Basic Attack - Huntress
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack - Huntress
Hold Normal Attack to continuously fire at enemies at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
- Hold and then release Normal Attack while Rebecca is not casting Tactical Dodge - Huntress to cast Heavy Attack - Eat Lead!: Huntress

Heavy Attack - Eat Lead!: Huntress
Deal Electro DMG.

Comin' in Hot! - Huntress
Somersault in mid-air and land.
Keep holding Normal Attack after casting this skill to follow up with Heavy Attack - Huntress without consuming STA.

Mid-air Plunging Attack - Huntress
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter - Huntress
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to strike the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Tactical Dodge - Huntress
Press Dodge to attack the target while dodging, dealing Electro DMG.
Can be cast during the following actions (while on the ground):
- Performing Basic Attack - Huntress.
- Performing Heavy Attack - Huntress.
- Performing Heavy Attack - Eat Lead!: Huntress
- Casting Comin' in Hot! - Huntress.
- Casting Tactical Dodge - Huntress.
- Casting Resonance Skill.
- Casting Intro Skill.
Additional Electro DMG is dealt upon a successful Dodge during Tactical Dodge - Huntress.
Keep holding Normal Attack after casting this skill to follow up with Heavy Attack - Huntress without consuming STA.

Basic Attack - Guts
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.
Casting Tactical Dodge - Guts does not reset Basic Attack - Huntress's attack cycle within a certain time.

Heavy Attack - Guts
Consume STA and attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Mid-air Plunging Attack - Guts
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter - Guts
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to strike the target, dealing Electro DMG.

- The Guts mode allows Rebecca to ignore 15% of the target's DEF.

Rebecca inflicts Hack - Shifting upon dealing damage to the targets through the following skills. The same skill can trigger this effect once every 3s:
Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!, Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress, Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts, and Resonance Liberation - BOOM! Fireworks!.

Deal Electro DMG to all targets affected by Hack - Interfered within the range, considered Hack DMG.

During Heavy Attack - Huntress, if Fervor is at 120 points and Rebecca is not in the action of Tactical Dodge - Huntress, release Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress.

Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts
At 120 points of Fervor, Heavy Attack - Guts is replaced with Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts. Hold Normal Attack  to cast Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts, which consumes all Fervor to pull in nearby targets and deal Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

Fervor

Normal Attacks restore Fervor upon damaging the target.
Resonance Skill restores Fervor upon damaging the target.
When A Girl Gets What She Wants! is gained by casting Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time! or Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, Rebecca restores 50 points of Fervor.

Hot Hand
Rebecca can hold up to 120 points of Hot Hand.
Regenerates over time at a rate of 10 points per second.
Casting Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress or Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts restores 40 points.

At 120 points of Hot Hand, casting Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!, Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, Resonance Skill - It's Big Boomin' Time!, or Resonance Skill - Come 'n' Get Me! grants the following effects for 12s:

The next time Sigrika obtains a Rune, she additionally obtains a Rune of the same type and removes Convergent.

nodes.description:
When any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Sigrika gains a stack of Blessing of Runes, up to 6 stacks. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once.

Blessing of Runes
Each stack of Blessing of Runes grants the active Resonator in the team 3% Aero DMG Bonus and 3% Echo Skill DMG Bonus.
When Blessing of Runes reaches 6 stacks, Sigrika additionally gains 30% Aero DMG Bonus and Echo Skill DMG Bonus.

nodes.description:
Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes
Hold Normal Attack to consume two Runes and cast Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes, dealing Aero DMG. Based on the types of the Runes consumed, Sigrika gains the following effects:
- When consuming Rune: Trust and Rune: Answer, this skill gains the effect of Runic Outburst.
- When consuming two Runes: Trust, this skill gains the effect of Runic Chain Whip.
- When consuming two Runes: Answer, this skill gains the effect of Runic Soliskin.
When consuming Runes, if Sigrika holds at least 30 points of Soliskin Vitality, consume 30 points to increase the DMG Multipliers of the current Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, and Runic Soliskin by 50%. Obtain a stack of Innate Gift?.
When consuming Runes, if Soliskin Vitality is lower than 30 points, consume all Soliskin Vitality. Every 10 points of Soliskin Vitality consumed grants the current Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, and Runic Soliskin 15% DMG Amplification.
Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes deals Echo Skill DMG.

Runic Outburst
Deal Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Runic Chain Whip
Stagnate nearby targets and deal Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Runic Soliskin
Pull in nearby targets and deal Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name
When Full Stop reaches 100 points, if Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name is not on Cooldown, press Resonance Skill to cast Resonance Skill - BOOMY BOOM! or Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid. Hold Resonance Skill to consume all Full Stop to cast Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name, dealing Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Innate Gift?
Sigrika can hold up to 2 stacks of Innate Gift?. Each stack grants Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, Runic Soliskin and Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name 30% DMG Amplification.
This effect ends after Sigrika casts Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name or is switched off the field.

Rune
Sigrika holds up to 4 Runes. Without Full Stop, Sigrika can only hold up to 2 Runes. When Sigrika gains a new Rune at max capacity, the existing Runes shift one slot to the left, removing the leftmost Rune. With at least 50 points of Full Stop, Sigrika can hold 2 additional Runes.
Hitting a target directly with Basic Attack - Elucidated or Dodge Counter - Decipher in the duration of the moves grants one Rune: Trust.
Hitting a target directly with Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM! or Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid in the duration of the moves grants one Rune: Answer.

Full Stop
After casting Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes, gain 50 points of Full Stop, up to 100 points.

Soliskin Vitality
When any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Sigrika gains 10 points of Soliskin Vitality, up to 60 points. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once. Casting Outro Skill - In This Very Moment resets the record of Echo triggering this effect.

Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance

Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance.

Awakening Spring
While in Zephyr Stance and at full Cloud Breath, Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance is replaced with Awakening Spring. Casting this skill consumes all Cloud Breath, pulls in nearby targets, and sends Suisui into Drizzle Stance, dealing Glacio DMG and inflicting Glacio Chafe on the target 1 time on hit.

Enrichment
Casting Awakening Spring or Intro Skill - Tinkling Jade grants all nearby Resonators in the team 1 stack of Enrichment. This effect can be triggered once every 25s. Incoming Resonators receive healing from Suisui at the cost of Enrichment.

Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance
While in Drizzle Stance, Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance is replaced with Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance.

nodes.description:
Casting the skill deploys Ceaseless Landscape that lasts for 30s. When Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui enters the Roaming Transcendent state when casting Outro Skill - Rippling Waters.
Ceaseless Landscape grants all nearby Resonators in the team the following enhancements:
- Inflicting a target with Spectro Frazzle, Fusion Burst, Glacio Chafe, and Aero Erosion, or dealing the corresponding Negative Status DMG increases the max stack limit of the corresponding Negative Status the target can receive by 3 for 15s. This effect does not stack.
- Inflicting a target with Electro Flare or dealing the corresponding Negative Status DMG increases the max stack limits of Electro Flare and Electro Rage the target can receive by 3 for 15s. This effect does not stack.
- Consuming Havoc Bane stacks on the target after landing a skill allows the Resonator's Havoc DMG to ignore the target's DEF by 6% and Havoc RES by 12% for 30s. This effect does not stack.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

nodes.description:
Consuming Enrichment grants the Resonator 10 stacks of Spring's Birth, up to 10 stacks. When the Resonator with Spring's Birth is not at full HP, restore their HP by 62 + 0.34% of Suisui's Max HP at the cost of 1 stack of Spring's Birth every 2s.

When Resonance Skill - Awakening Spring and Intro Skill - Tinkling Jade hit a target, they additionally restore 18 points of Concerto Energy and 13 points of Resonance Energy, and increase the attack's Crit. Rate by 80% and Glacio DMG by 240%. This effect can be triggered up to once every 25s.

nodes.name: Lambent Gold
nodes.description:
Zephyr Stance
Suisui is in Zephyr Stance by default. When in Zephyr Stance, Suisui can obtain Cloud Breath through certain skills.

Drizzle Stance
Entering Drizzle Stance clears all Floral Epistle.
During Drizzle Stance:
- Suisui unlocks new combat moves and restores Floral Epistle through certain skills.
-Suisui gains increased resistance to interruption.
- Press Normal Attack within a certain time after triggering a successful Dodge via Dodge skills to cast Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 1.
After entering Drizzle Stance for 15s, Suisui ends Drizzle Stance and clears all Floral Epistle upon exiting the state.

Dodge - Parting Mist
While performing attacks on the ground, press Dodge to cast Dodge - Parting Mist at the cost of STA.
When in Zephyr Stance, triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist restores Cloud Breath. Press Normal Attack shortly after triggering the Dodge to cast Dodge Counter - Zephyr Stance.
- When in Drizzle Stance, triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist restores Floral Epistle, and does not reset the cycle of Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance within a certain period.

Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance
When in Drizzle Stance, Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance is replaced with Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance.
Press Normal Attack repeatedly to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Floral Epistle on hit.
When casting Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 3, continuously pull in nearby targets.
Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 4 inflicts Glacio Chafe 1 time on the target on hit.

Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Floral Epistle on hit.

Illuminating Dew
When in Drizzle Stance, keep holding Normal Attack after casting Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance to cast this skill.
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.

Swallow's Cut
When in Drizzle Stance, cast this skill in one of the following ways:
- Release the Normal Attack button while casting Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance.
- Press Normal Attack while Suisui is mid-air.
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.

Cloud Breath
Max 120 points.
When in Zephyr Stance:
- Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance and Dodge Counter - Zephyr Stance restore Cloud Breath on hit.
- Casting Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance restores 40 points of Cloud Breath when Suisui is the active Resonator in the team.
- Triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist restores 35 points of Cloud Breath.

Floral Epistle
Max 600 points.
When in Drizzle Stance:
- Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance and Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance restore Floral Epistle on hit.
- Casting Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance restores 100 points of Floral Epistle when Suisui is the active Resonator in the team.
- Triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist restores 102 points of Floral Epistle.

nodes.name: Rippling Waters
nodes.description:
Resonators in the team gain 25% All DMG Amplification for 30s.

Suisui enters Roaming Transcendent when Ceaseless Landscape is active.
Suisui exits Drizzle Stance and consumes all Floral Epistle and unlocks the following effects based on the amount of Floral Epistle consumed:

0 Floral Epistle consumed:
- All nearby Resonators in the team gain Reflecting Shadows for 6s. Resonators with Reflecting Shadows have increased resistance to interruption.

At least 200 Floral Epistle consumed:
- If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui may perform Plume Step for the first time within a certain time into her Transcendent Dance while in Roaming Transcendent.

At least 400 Floral Epistle consumed:
- During this Roaming Transcendent state, the active Resonator within the Ceaseless Landscape deals more DMG if they have Reflecting Shadows. For every 1% of Suisui's Energy Regen over 200%, the Resonator deals 0.2% more DMG, up to 12%.
- If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui may perform the second Plume Step within a certain time into her Transcendent Dance while in Roaming Transcendent.

At least 600 Floral Epistle consumed:
- When Suisui performs the first Plume Step, all nearby active Resonators in the team within the Ceaseless Landscape gain the following effects for the duration of this Roaming Transcendent:
- When they cast Outro Skill, Suisui grants the incoming Resonator Undulating Mist. When Resonators with Undulating Mist consume Negative Status or Electro Rage stacks on the target, they gain an ATK increase: For every 0.12% of Suisui's Energy Regen over 200%, the Resonator's ATK is increased by 0.1% for 6s, up to 50%. Undulating Mist lasts for 14s or until the Resonator is switched off the field. When Undulating Mist is removed, the ATK increase effect is also removed.
- If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui may perform the third Plume Step within a certain time into her Transcendent Dance while in Roaming Transcendent.

Roaming Transcendent
Lasts for 30s.
During Roaming Transcendent, Suisui will merge with Ceaseless Landscape and start a Transcendent Dance, during which she will perform Plume Steps at intervals based on the amount of Floral Epistle consumed when Outro Skill - Rippling Waters is cast.
When Suisui is the active Resonator in the team, she stops the Transcendent Dance.
When Ceaseless Landscape isn't active, she will exit the Roaming Transcendent state.

Plume Step
Performing Plume Step grants Reflecting Shadows to all nearby Resonators in the team for 6s, inflicts 1 stack of Glacio Chafe on all enemies within the Ceaseless Landscape, and heals the nearby active Resonators in the team within the Ceaseless Landscape.

- Generate a segment of Deductive Data every second;

Using up all STA or actions such as casting Basic Attack will end the Unbound Form and deal Spectro DMG to the target. Each accumulated segment of Deductive Data will convert into a segment of Empirical Data and generate a Collapsed Core.

nodes.description:
Outer Stellarealm
Generate the Outer Stellarealm to restore HP for all party members within its effective range continuously. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.

Inner Stellarealm
When a party member uses Intro Skill within the Outer Stellarealm, it evolves into the Inner Stellarealm. Within the effective range of the Inner Stellarealm, for every 0.2% of Shorekeeper's Energy Regen, all party members gain a 0.01% increase of Crit. Rate, up to 12.5%.

Supernal Stellarealm

nodes.description:
Enlightenment
Shorekeeper appears to restore HP for all nearby party members and summon 5 Dim Star Butterflies, which automatically track and attack a target, dealing Spectro DMG. This is considered Resonance Skill DMG.

Discernment
When a Supernal Stellarealm is generated, Shorekeeper's first Intro Skill triggered in its duration will be replaced with Intro Skill Discernment. Casting Discernment ends the current Stellarealm, restores HP for all nearby party members, and deals Spectro DMG to the targets. This attack is guaranteed to be a Critical Hit dealing Resonance Liberation DMG. The Intro Skill Discernment can only be triggered once each time a Supernal Stellarealm is generated.

nodes.name: Astral Chord
nodes.description:
Flare Star Butterfly
Hitting a target with a Normal Attack generates a Collapsed Core, which transforms into a Flare Star Butterfly after 6s. Flare Star Butterflies automatically track and attack a target, dealing Spectro DMG. If there are already 5 Collapsed Cores, Shorekeeper's next Basic Attack hit will instantly convert a Collapsed Core into a Flare Star Butterfly.

Illation
When Shorekeeper has 5 segments of Empirical Data, casting Heavy Attack will consume all segments to pull in nearby targets, dealing Spectro DMG. Meanwhile, all generated Collapsed Cores will instantly transform into Flare Star Butterflies.

Transmutation
When Shorekeeper has 5 segments of Empirical Data, casting Mid-air Attack will consume all segments to deal Spectro DMG. Meanwhile, all generated Collapsed Cores will instantly transform into Flare Star Butterflies. Quickly press the Normal Attack Button afterward to perform Basic Attack Stage 2.

Empirical Data
Shorekeeper can hold up to 5 segments of Empirical Data.
- Obtain 1 segment of Empirical Data when Basic Attack Stage 1, 2, or 4 hits a target.
- Obtain 2 segments of Empirical Data when Basic Attack Stage 3 hits a target.
- Obtain 1 segment of Empirical Data when Mid-air Attack hits a target.
- Obtain 1 segment of Empirical Data when Dodge Counter hits a target.

The Resonator launched in the air can land on the ground standing if they are close to the ground. This effect can be triggered up to 5 time(s).
- All nearby party members' DMG is Amplified by 15%.

When Yangyang has 3 Melodies, she can cast Stormy Strike after Heavy Attack or Dodge Counter, dealing Aero DMG.

Mid-air Attack: Feather Release
When Yangyang has 3 Melodies, cast Basic Attack in mid-air to consume all Melodies and perform consecutive strikes, diving from mid-air, dealing Aero DMG. As Yangyang lands, she sheathes her sword with an attack, dealing Aero DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG.

Melody
Yangyang can hold up to 3 Melodies

Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance

Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 4 applies 1 stack of Havoc Bane to the targets hit.

Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance
Press Normal Attack repeatedly or hold it down to consume Melody and perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG. While Melody is not depleted, the Energy Regen is increased by 20% when Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance deals damage.
Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 4 applies 1 stack of Havoc Bane to the targets hit.

Mid-air Attack - Azure Sword Stance
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, consuming Melody and dealing Havoc DMG.
Pressing Normal Attack within a short time after casting this skill triggers Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 2.

Mid-air Attack - Feather Sword Stance
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, consuming Melody and dealing Havoc DMG.
Pressing Normal Attack within a short time after casting this skill triggers Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Azure Sword Stance
Pressing Normal Attack within a short time after a successful Dodge consumes Melody to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
Pressing Normal Attack within a short time after casting this skill triggers Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 3.
Casting Dodge Counter - Azure Sword Stance counts as casting Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 2.

A successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes 50 Melody.
After casting this skill, the Basic Attack cycle will not reset for a short time.

nodes.description:

Consume all Melody to deal Havoc DMG and restore 1 point of Azure Plume. This DMG is considered Heavy Attack DMG.

Upon casting this skill, obtain Voice upon Voice. When casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, summon Shadow of Xuanling to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.

nodes.name: One Life, One Blade
nodes.description:
Resonance Liberation Hush of a Thousand Voices raises the Havoc Bane stacks on the targets to the maximum on hit.

When nearby Resonators in the team inflict Havoc Bane, Yangyang: Xuanling gains 1 stack of Windbound. Windbound can be gained once every 1s, stacking up to 6 times.

When Windbound reaches 6 stacks, Yangyang: Xuanling removes all Windbound and gains One with the Wind.
While One with the Wind lasts, when Yangyang: Xuanling casts Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, she summons Feather Release: Xuanling to attack the target, applying 6 stacks of Havoc Bane to the target.
Windbound cannot be obtained while One with the Wind lasts.

Once Feather Release: Xuanling is summoned, the One with the Wind state is removed.

Deal Havoc DMG and restore 1 points of Azure Plume.

nodes.name: The Way of Ten Thousand Voices
nodes.description:
Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure
Yangyang: Xuanling is in Azure Sword Stance by default. When Melody is depleted while in Feather Sword Stance, Resonance Skill - Feather's Edge is replaced by Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure.
Press Resonance Skill to switch to Azure Sword Stance and cast Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, dealing Havoc DMG and restoring 100 points of Melody and 1 points of Azure Plume. This instance of DMG is considered Heavy Attack DMG.
When Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure hits the target, consume 1 stacks of Havoc Bane on the target.
The Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance cycle is not reset within a short time after casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure. If casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure resets the cycle, summon a Wraith of Sound to finish the current attack and deal a fixed instance of Havoc DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG, which is not affected by any DMG Bonus effects and does not inflict Havoc Bane.
Successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes 50 points of Melody.

Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather
When Melody is depleted while in Azure Sword Stance, Resonance Skill - Feather's Edge is replaced by Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather.
Press Resonance Skill to switch to Feather Sword Stance and cast Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, dealing Havoc DMG and restoring 100 points of Melody and 1 points of Azure Plume. This instance of DMG is considered Heavy Attack DMG.
When Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather hits, consume 1 stacks of Havoc Bane on the target.
The Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance cycle is not reset within a short time after casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather. If casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather resets the cycle, summon a Wraith of Sound to finish the current attack and deal a fixed instance of Havoc DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG, which is not affected by any DMG Bonus effects and does not inflict Havoc Bane.
Successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes 50 points of Melody.

Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance
When Azure Plume is restored to its maximum while in Azure Sword Stance, hold Normal Attack to consume STA and all Azure Plume to cast Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, generating a massive cyclone that strikes the area in front, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
When casting Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, gain Bated Breath: If Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the field, the Crit. DMG of this Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance increases by 160%. When Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance ends, Bated Breath is removed. Bated Breath can be gained up to once every 25s.
Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance applies 2 stacks of Havoc Bane to the targets hit.

Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance
When Azure Plume is restored to its maximum while in Feather Sword Stance, if Yangyang: Xuanling is on the ground and not in a Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom cycle, hold Normal Attack to consume STA and cast Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, dealing Havoc DMG. After it hits a target, Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall is automatically cast.
When casting Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, gain Streaming Storm, which lasts 15s. While Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the team, the Crit. DMG of this Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance or the next Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, or Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom is increased by 160%. Streaming Storm is removed when Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom Stage 3 or Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom Stage 3 ends. Streaming Storm can be gained up to once every 25s.
Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance applies 2 stacks of Havoc Bane to the targets hit.

Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall
When Azure Plume is restored to its maximum while in Feather Sword Stance and airborne, Mid-air Attack - Feather Sword Stance is replaced by Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall.
Press or hold Normal Attack to consume STA and all Azure Plume to cast Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG. Casting Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall enters Hark the Wind for 12s.

Hark the Wind
While in Feather Sword Stance, Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance is replaced by Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, which performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom Stage 2 and Stage 3 can be cast in mid-air close to the ground. Casting Stage 3 ends Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom. This attack cycle cannot be reset.
During Hark the Wind, a Dodge Counter counts towards the Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom cycle.

Feathered Oath
When nearby Resonators in the team inflict Havoc Bane on a target, Yangyang: Xuanling gains 1 stack of Feathered Oath for 4s. Feathered Oath can be gained once every 1s, stacking up to 6 times. While Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the team, each stack increases the Crit. DMG of Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, and Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom by 25%, up to 150%.

Refrain
Before Yangyang: Xuanling's Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 4, Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 4, Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, or Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance hits a target, record and propagate the highest stack count of Havoc Bane on targets within a certain range to all targets within range.

Melody
Melody has a maximum of 100 points.
Casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather restores 100 points of Melody.
Casting Resonance Liberation Hush of a Thousand Voices consumes all Melody.
Normal Attacks consumes Melody upon dealing damage.
Successful Dodge can be triggered during the action of Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Azure, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Feather, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather within a certain time of casting these skills, which consumes 50 points of Melody.

Azure Plume
Azure Plume has a maximum of 2 points.
Casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, or Intro Skill - Skybound Feather restores 1 points of Azure Plume.
Casting Resonance Liberation - Hush of a Thousand Voices restores 1 points of Azure Plume.
Casting Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance or Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall consumes all Azure Plume.

nodes.name: Zapstring's Dance
nodes.description:
Basic Attack
Yinlin controls the puppet "Zapstring" to perform up to 4 attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack
Yinlin consumes STA to control "Zapstring", dealing Electro DMG.

Mid-air Attack
Yinlin consumes STA to control "Zapstring" to perform a Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter
Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

nodes.name: Magnetic Roar
nodes.description:
Magnetic Roar
The puppet "Zapstring" deals Electro DMG to the target, and puts Yinlin in Resonance Skill Execution Mode.

Execution Mode
Basic Attack and Dodge Counter will trigger 1 Electromagnetic Blast when hitting a target.
Each stage of Basic Attack or Dodge Counter can only trigger 1 Electromagnetic Blast, up to 4 times.

Electromagnetic Blast
Attack all targets marked with Forte Circuit Sinner's Mark, dealing Electro DMG.

Lightning Execution
Use Resonance Skill after casting Resonance Skill Magnetic Roar to cast Lightning Execution to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
If Resonance Skill Lightning Execution is not activated in a while or this Character is switched, this Skill will be put on Cooldown.

nodes.name: Thundering Wrath
nodes.description: Command "Zapstring" to call for thunder to fall upon a large range, dealing Electro DMG.

nodes.name: Pain Immersion
nodes.description: After using Resonance Skill Magnetic Roar, Yinlin's Crit. Rate is increased by 15% for 5s.

nodes.name: Deadly Focus
nodes.description: The damage of Resonance Skill Lightning Execution is increased by 10% when hitting targets marked with Sinner's Mark, and Yinlin's ATK is increased by 10% for 4s when this is triggered.

nodes.name: Raging Storm
nodes.description: Command puppet "Zapstring" to attack, dealing Electro DMG in a large range.

nodes.name: Chameleon Cipher
nodes.description:
Chameleon Cipher
When Yinlin's Judgment Points are full, her Heavy Attack is replaced with Chameleon Cipher, which consumes all Judgment Points to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG. When it hits a target marked with Sinner's Mark, the Sinner's Mark is replaced with Punishment Mark, lasting for 18s. Chameleon Cipher deals Heavy Attack DMG.

Sinner's Mark
Basic Attack Zapstring's Dance, Resonance Liberation Thundering Wrath, and Intro Skill Roaring Storm apply Sinner's Mark to the target on hit.
Sinner's Mark is removed when Yinlin is switched out.

Punishment Mark
When a target marked with Punishment Mark takes damage, Judgement Strike will fall, triggering Coordinated Attacks to all targets marked with Punishment Mark, dealing Electro DMG. This can be triggered up to 1 time per second. Judgement Strike deals Resonance Skill DMG.

Judgment Points
Yinlin can hold up to 100 Judgement Points. Yinlin gains Judgement Points through the following ways:
Upon casting Intro Skill Raging Storm
When Basic Attack Zapstring's Dance hits a target
Upon casting Resonance Skill Magnetic Roar;
When Resonance Skill Electromagnetic Blast hits a target;
Upon casting Resonance Skill Lightning Execution.

nodes.name: Strategist
nodes.description: The incoming Resonator has their Electro DMG Amplified by 20% and Resonance Liberation DMG Amplified by 25% for 14s or until they are switched out.

nodes.name: Frosty Punches
nodes.description:
Basic Attack
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG.

Heavy Attack
- When Frost is full, hold the Normal Attack Button to cast Frostfall.
- When Frost is full during the Fortune Rolling state, release the Normal Attack Button to cast Frostfall. If Youhu cannot cast Frostfall at the moment, perform Lucky Draw once instead.
Youhu can obtain Frost in the following ways:
- When Frost is not full, hold Normal Attack Button to enter the Fortune Rolling state and restore Frost over time.
- When Basic Attacks hit a target.

Heavy Attack: Frostfall
Youhu dashes forward, dealing Glacio DMG, and performs Lucky Draw once.

Mid-air Attack
Perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Glacio DMG.

Dodge Counter
When Youhu possesses no Antique, quickly press Normal Attack Button right after a successful Dodge to thrust forward, dealing Glacio DMG, and perform Lucky Draw once.

nodes.name: Scroll Divination
nodes.description:
Youhu smashes her scroll down at the enemy, dealing Glacio DMG, restoring HP for all party members nearby, and performs Lucky Draw once.

Lucky Draw
Youhu obtains a random Antique after the Lucky Draw. With an Antique, her next Basic Attack will activate the corresponding Antique Appraisal.
Only one Antique can exist at a time, and the newly drawn Antique will replace the existing one.

Antique Appraisal
- Chime: Attack the enemy with a Chime, dealing Glacio DMG. Chime can effectively reduce the enemy's Vibration Strength.
- Ruyi: Batter the enemy with a Ruyi, dealing Glacio DMG. Ruyi has a higher DMG Multiplier.
- Ding: Ram into the enemy on a Ding, dealing Glacio DMG. Ding can effectively break the enemy's stance.
- Mask: Throw a Mask at enemies in front, dealing Glacio DMG. Mask can pull in enemies along its path.

nodes.name: Fortune's Favor
nodes.description:
Youhu hurls her scroll at the enemy, causing a Glacio DMG blast in the area.
On the blast, four buttons will appear. Choose a button within the specified time to obtain the corresponding Antique. Otherwise, obtain one random Antique.

nodes.name: Treasured Piece
nodes.description: Restore HP for all nearby party members based on 30% of the healing provided by Resonance Skill Scroll Divination when Resonance Skill Antique Appraisal is cast.

nodes.name: Rare Find
nodes.description: Gain 15% Glacio DMG Bonus for 14s upon casting Intro Skill Scroll of Wonders.

nodes.name: Scroll of Wonders
nodes.description: Toss out the scroll and perform Lucky Draw once.

nodes.name: Poetic Essence
nodes.description:
At four Auspices, hold the Normal Attack button to release Poetic Essence, dealing Glacio DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG, while restoring HP for all nearby party members.
Youhu can hold up to four Auspices.

Poetic Essence
Deal Glacio DMG to enemies within the range and additionally obtain one of the following effects based on the Auspice combination:
- Free Verse: Four different types Auspices. Additionally reduce the Vibration Strength of hit enemies.
- Antithesis: A pair of Auspices. Increase Poetic Essence's DMG by 70%.
- Double Pun: Two pairs of Auspices. Additionally restore HP for all nearby party members.
- Triplet: Three identical Auspices. Increase Poetic Essence's DMG by 175%.
- Perfect Rhyme: Four identical Auspices. Simultaneously activate the effects of Free Verse, Double Pun, and Triplet.
Casting Poetic Essence removes all Auspices.

Auspice
- Youhu gains an Auspice through Antique Appraisal. Use Basic Attack while holding an Antique to receive the corresponding Auspice.
- Youhu unlocks Antiques by casting Resonance Skill Scroll Divination, Intro Skill Scroll of Wonders, Heavy Attack Frostfall, Resonance Liberation Fortune's Favor, and Dodge Counter.

nodes.description: The incoming Resonator has their Coordinated Attack DMG Amplified by 100% for 28s.

nodes.name: Reserved Confidence
nodes.description: The ranges of the Resonance Skills Thunder Field and Thunder Uprising are greatly expanded. When switched off the field during combat, if "Readiness" is not full, Yuanwu will automatically leave 1 Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge in place.

nodes.name: Thunder Bombardment
nodes.description: Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

nodes.name: Unassuming Blade
nodes.description:
Rumbling Spark
When "Readiness" is full, hold Resonance Skill to consume all "Readiness" and cast Rumbling Spark, dealing Electro DMG and entering the Lightning Infused state.

Thunder Uprising
When "Readiness" is full, Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge will be replaced with Thunder Uprising, dealing Electro DMG.

Lightning Infused
The character in Lightning Infused state has a greatly increased resistance to interruption.
When Yuanwu is in this state:
-Basic Attacks: Hit targets in a larger range, reduce enemy Vibration Strength with increased efficiency.
-Heavy Attacks: Have increased attack speed, reduce enemy Vibration Strength with increased efficiency.
-Dodge Counters: Have increased attack speed, reduce enemy Vibration Strength with increased efficiency.
-Use Basic Attack within 3s after casting a Heavy Attack or a successful Counterattack to cast Thunderweaver, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG.
-Does not recover "Readiness".

Readiness
Yuanwu can hold up to 100 "Readiness".
When Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge is on the field, Yuanwu gains 6 "Readiness" every second, even when he is not the active character;
When Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge hits a target with a Coordinated Attack, Yuanwu gains 5 "Readiness".
